notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
